source_lock.edition: Incompressible Box Transport and Finite Computation, October 6 2026

definitions: a=L/(2*pi)>0; xi_k=k/a; normalized spatial Fourier measure; k in Z^3
P(k)=I-xi_k xi_k^T/|xi_k|^2 and Q(k)=xi_k xi_k^T/|xi_k|^2 for k!=0; for mean-zero g, both zero at k=0
phi_hat(k)=-i(xi_k dot g_hat(k))/|xi_k|^2 for k!=0, phi_hat(0)=0
source_level_quantitative_audit.tail: For N>=1, sum_{|k|_infinity>N}(1+|xi_k|^2)^(-2) <=26 a^4 sum_{n>N}n^(-2)<=26 a^4/N. Square-root tail factor sqrt(26 a^4/N).
source_level_quantitative_audit.projection: For each nonzero k, P(k),Q(k) are orthogonal complementary projections of Euclidean operator norm <=1. Hence ||Pg||_{H^s},||Qg||_{H^s}<=||g||_{H^s}.
source_level_quantitative_audit.sobolev_to_uniform: Cauchy-Schwarz and |xi_k^beta|<=(1+|xi_k|^2)^(|beta|/2) give ||G||_{C^r}<=S_L||G||_{H^(r+2)}. Combining with P,Q and phi yields the displayed S_L and S_L*d_L bounds for all integer r>=0; temporal derivatives commute with time-independent Fourier multipliers for smooth g.
source_level_quantitative_audit.gauge: -grad(p-phi)+Pg=-grad p+g, with phi spatial mean zero, so the pressure's spatial mean normalization is preserved.
finite_mode_checks: Longitudinal mean-zero g=(sin(2*pi*x_1/L),0,0) has Pg=0, Qg=g and phi=-(L/(2*pi))*cos(2*pi*x_1/L).
Transverse mean-zero g=(0,sin(2*pi*x_1/L),0) has Pg=g, Qg=0, phi=0.
